_meta.description: Canonical percentage-of-completion stages for consultancy project revenue recognition under RJ 270 (Richtlijnen voor de Jaarverslaggeving §270) and IFRS 15 §B14-B19.

stages.label: Initiatie
stages.description: Project is in the initiation phase. Contract signed; work not yet substantially commenced. Percentage-of-completion: 0–10%.
stages.statutoryNote: RJ 270 §3.2: revenue recognised only to the extent of recoverable costs in early stages.

stages.label: Uitvoering
stages.description: Project is in active execution. The majority of deliverables are in progress. Percentage-of-completion: 10–85%.
stages.statutoryNote: RJ 270 §3.2 / IFRS 15 §B14-B19: cost-to-cost or output-based percentage drives recognised revenue.

stages.label: Afronding
stages.description: Project deliverables are substantially complete; closeout activities and final acceptance in progress. Percentage-of-completion: 85–99%.
stages.statutoryNote: RJ 270 §3.2: final acceptance not yet signed; retain small uncompleted portion unrealised.

stages.label: Afgerond
stages.description: Project is fully delivered and accepted by the customer. All deliverables signed off. Percentage-of-completion: 100%.
stages.statutoryNote: RJ 270 §3.2 / IFRS 15 §B14-B19: 100% completion — full contract value may be recognised.
